name: Flying Colours
scope: Yes if it is a country's flag first being raised
boundary: Flying Colours: a national flag first raised or adopted; independence itself goes to Flags Come Down, countries' founding moments to Nations of Europe, colonial footholds to Flag Planted.
example_beats: The Dannebrog falls from the sky at Lyndanisse (1219)
The Flag Act adopts the Stars and Stripes (1777)
Italy's tricolore first flown at Reggio Emilia (1797)
The Union Flag gains the cross of St Patrick (1801)
Brazil raises its green and gold flag (1889)
The Australian flag is first flown (1901)
notes: Famous flags only, dated to when each was first hoisted or officially adopted.
